rationale: Record a test-only change to how Pulp's real-browser capture validation is launched. The pulp-browser-capture-node-integration ctest now runs its *.integration.test.mjs files through browser_capture/run_integration.mjs, which picks node --test's file concurrency at run time from the executing machine's cores (1 below 6 cores, 3 otherwise), because a fixed width of 3 timed out every capture on a 3-vCPU gate VM. The test files, cases, RUN_SERIAL isolation and timeouts are unchanged. Production browser capture, design ingest, captured output, rendering, packaging, the accepted expansion boundary, and Vellum source authority are unchanged.
